wiki.summary: “off that!” is the promotional single for OsamaSon’s upcoming album, nocturnal. It was released on May 20, 2026 which is the same day of OsamaSon's 23rd birthday. The track was first previewed on May 10, 2026, during OsamaSon’s 2026 Rolling Loud Orlando performance as the closer for his set. A short, low-quality snippet surfaced online on May 16, 2026. A day later, creative posse Black Orchid teased an upcoming music video and a new snippet of the track on their Instagram story. Read more on Last.fm.
